question: Why can a magnet catch some fake diamonds but not real ones?
answer: Many lab-made diamonds are produced by HPHT, a high-pressure, high-temperature process that uses added metals. Those metals make the stone magnetic, so it jumps to a magnet. A real diamond stays put.
move: A diamond that jumps to a magnet was likely made in a lab.
